name: docs-that-run
description: Validate the runnable examples in Markdown documentation. Scans by default and only executes blocks explicitly marked dtr-run, after the user confirms.

interface.shortDescription: Validate marked Python and Bash examples in Markdown
interface.longDescription: Scan local Markdown documentation and, with explicit user authorization, execute only Python and Bash blocks marked dtr-run.
defaultPrompt: Scan my Markdown documentation for marked runnable examples.
Validate the dtr-run blocks in this README without executing them.
